pr.title: feat(dcp): dcp accept + approval reader + scanner consumers (DMX-DCP-TOOLING-110)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Implements `dopemux dcp accept --tp <TP-ID> [--decision allow|gated|refuse] --as <identity>`: writes proof/<tp>/APPROVAL.json conforming to dcp_approval_artifact schema.
- Enforces: TTY required + typed confirmation phrase (refuses when non-interactive per design D-E); requester != approver at write time; --tp sanitized to ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$; requester sourced from PROOF.json implementer identity; approver from --as (asserted, labeled); head_sha populated via live git read (D-E carve-out).
- Registers dcp.accept as T6 capability in config/orchestrator/approval_policy.yaml.
- Adds proof_family.py family DCP_APPROVAL_ARTIFACT: classify + expose fields; honor expiry_window.
- Adds scanner consumers: (1) AGENT-APPROVED-MERGE-WITHOUT-SUPERVISOR builtin detector — merge-readiness artifact present without valid fresh APPROVAL.json → BLOCKER; (2) B.6 sanctioned-change downgrade — PROOF-CONTRACT-SCHEMA-MUTATION finding downgrades to WARNING when valid APPROVAL.json is present and covers flagged paths.
- Delivers docs/dcp/adapter-contract-approval-steward.md documenting the adapter contract for future steward/classifier rewiring (out of scope here).

## Validation
- write → classify → scan integration test.
- requester == approver rejected.
- Non-TTY refusal verified.
- Path traversal attempts rejected.
- Expired approval treated as invalid.
- AGENT-APPROVED-MERGE-WITHOUT-SUPERVISOR BLOCKER fires without approval.
- Sanctioned-change downgrade demonstrated with valid approval.

## NOT_RUN
- Steward/classifier rewiring (out of scope, adapter contract doc only).
- Cryptographic identity (V2).

steps.task: Preflight: inspect dcp_approval_artifact schema, current approval_policy.yaml, proof_family.py, and red_lane_scanner.py AGENT-APPROVED-MERGE-WITHOUT-SUPERVISOR builtin status.
validation: Scanner builtin detector status for AGENT-APPROVED-MERGE-WITHOUT-SUPERVISOR confirmed.

steps.task: Implement src/dopemux/dcp/approval.py with write_approval_artifact(tp_id, decision, approver, proof_path) function and supporting logic. Enforce: (1) check sys.stdin.isatty() — refuse with non-zero exit and clear message when not TTY; (2) prompt for typed confirmation phrase before writing; (3) source requester from proof_path/PROOF.json implementer field; (4) assert requester != approver before write; (5) populate head_sha via live git read (subprocess git rev-parse HEAD); (6) populate mutation_class and red_lanes_present from C1/C3 context; (7) validate --tp against ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$ before any path construction; (8) write schema-valid proof/<tp>/APPROVAL.json.

Add DCP_APPROVAL_ARTIFACT family to src/dopemux/dcp/proof_family.py: classify proof artifacts, expose decision/requester/approver/head_sha/expiry_window fields, enforce expiry (stale approval → invalid). Register dcp.accept as T6 capability in config/orchestrator/approval_policy.yaml.

Implement scanner consumers in red_lane_scanner.py: (1) AGENT-APPROVED-MERGE-WITHOUT-SUPERVISOR builtin — when merge-readiness artifact is present in the diff without a valid non-expired APPROVAL.json covering the paths → emit BLOCKER finding; (2) B.6 sanctioned-change downgrade — when PROOF-CONTRACT-SCHEMA-MUTATION BLOCKER fires and a valid in-scope APPROVAL.json exists → downgrade to WARNING with approval artifact referenced in finding. Both consumers use the DCP_APPROVAL_ARTIFACT reader.

Write docs/dcp/adapter-contract-approval-steward.md documenting the adapter contract for future steward/classifier rewiring: how steward_gate.py should read APPROVAL.json via DCP_APPROVAL_ARTIFACT family, what fields it should use, expiry handling, and what behavior changes when a valid approval is present. This document is out-of-scope implementation guidance only — no steward code is changed in this TP.

No steward_gate.py or classifier.py changes in the diff.
